<?php
/**
 * DEV SITE ONLY (never in the plugin zip). Lets tests/e2e/run.mjs put a real
 * store's Klaviyo onsite script URL in this site's head, so "Use my Klaviyo
 * welcome offer" reads that store's live Klaviyo forms. type="text/plain":
 * the URL is in the HTML, nothing runs.
 */
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['ob_test_klaviyo'] ) && current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
		update_option( 'ob_test_klaviyo', preg_replace( '~[^A-Za-z0-9]~', '', (string) $_GET['ob_test_klaviyo'] ) );
		wp_die( 'ok', '', array( 'response' => 200 ) );
	}
} );
add_action( 'wp_head', function () {
	$id = get_option( 'ob_test_klaviyo' );
	if ( $id ) {
		printf( '<script type="text/plain" src="//static.klaviyo.com/onsite/js/%s/klaviyo.js?ver=3.8.3"></script>' . "\n", esc_attr( $id ) );
	}
} );
